annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1863 of 6 November 2019 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 as regards the withdrawal of references of harmonised standards for machinery from the Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1863 of 6 November 2019 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 as regards the withdrawal of references of harmonised standards for machinery from the Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 286/25
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending Decision 2019/436 on harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC. It extends withdrawal dates for references of several standards, defers withdrawal of EN 1870-13, and corrects recital 14. The annex lists standards, including one on robotic lawnmowers, with new withdrawal dates.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex III of Decision 2019/436 is replaced with a new list of standards and extended withdrawal dates.
Recital 14 corrected: EN ISO 12100:2010 is not withdrawn; only EN 786, EN 61496-1 and EN ISO 11200 are.
Presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC applies to machinery built to harmonised standards.
Extensions give manufacturers more time to adopt revised standards.
Enters into force twentieth day after publication; Article 1 applies from 19 March 2019.
